meta_prompt:
Write a prompt that classifies OSHA severe injury narratives into these event categories: Caught in or compressed by equipment or objects; Falls to lower level; Struck by object or equipment; Falls on same level; Nonroadway incidents involving motorized land vehicles; Exposure to temperature extremes; Pedestrian vehicular incident; Struck against object or equipment; Exposure to electricity; Exposure to other harmful substances; Fires; Overexertion involving outside sources; Other. Output only the category.

The prompt must contain the placeholder {narrative} exactly once, where the narrative will be inserted. Return only the prompt.
